Zak Chelli to fight on Sky Sports: From classroom to the ring - the supply teacher ready for Zuffa Boxing bow
Fulham fighter Zak Chelli has signed with Zuffa Boxing and will fight on Sky Sports; Chelli is coming off a tremendous upset win when he knocked out David Morrell; Chelli is a former British, Commonwealth and English champion looking to fight his way into world class
Wednesday 4 November 2026 15:30, UK
Zak Chelli has signed with Zuffa Boxing and will fight on Sky Sports.
Chelli, the fighting schoolteacher from Fulham, has signed a multi-fight contract with the company.
The Londoner is coming off the best win of his career when he produced a stunning knockout to shock David Morrell and catch the attention of the boxing world.
Cuba's Morrell is a top class light-heavyweight who previously held WBA regular titles at 168lbs and 175lbs. He went the distance in a competitive fight with the outstanding David Benavidez in a WBC Interim championship clash too.
Chelli is now looking to force his way to the top of the division. His Zuffa Boxing debut will be announced shortly.
A former British champion, Chelli defeated Jack Cullen to win the Lonsdale belt and the Commonwealth title.
Chelli has previously been an English titlist at super-middleweight, beating Germaine Brown back in 2022 to win that belt. He also upset the highly-touted American Anthony Sims Jr.
Defeated by Callum Simpson in their headline event at the Oakwell stadium in Barnsley, he bounced back to knock out Adam Hepple and win the English light-heavyweight title.
He joins Zuffa Boxing's vibrant light-heavyweight stable that includes Radivoje "Hot Rod" Kalajdzic, Joe Ward and more.
"I'm grateful for this opportunity. Zuffa is looking for fighters that they believe in, and I'm proud to be in that category," Chelli said.
"I'm thrilled that my fights will once again be shown on Sky Sports. I've fought on Sky many times, and they've always treated me well.
"I want to make the fights that the fans want to see. I'm ready to fight anyone, anytime, anywhere. I've proven that throughout my career."
Chelli, who works as a supply teacher at a secondary school in Surrey, stunned the boxing world with his Rocky-like KO for the ages.
He accepted the fight with the heavily favoured Morrell on two weeks' notice and then authored one of the biggest upsets in modern boxing history, overcoming an early deficit to knock out two-division titlist David Morrell in the 10th round.

זאק צ'לי, מתאגרף בריטי מלונדון המוכר גם כמורה מחליף בבית ספר תיכון, חתם על חוזה לריבוי קרבות עם חברת Zuffa Boxing ויחזור להופיע על מסכי סקיי ספורט. החתימה מגיעה בעקבות ניצחון מפתיע ומרשים שבו הצליח לנוקאאוט את דויד מורל הקובני בסיבוב העשירי, למרות שעלה לקרב בהתראה קצרה ביותר.
צ'לי, המחזיק בעברו בחגורות אליפות בריטניה, חבר העמים והאנגלית, מצטרף למועדון לוחמי המשקל הקל-כבד של החברה הכולל שמות מוכרים. הוא הביע את תודתו על ההזדמנות והצהיר כי הוא מוכן להילחם מול כל אחד, בכל זמן ובכל מקום.
